description.html: HabiStat Crested Gecko Diet Banana is a complete, nutritionally balanced food for crested geckos (Correlophus ciliatus) and other gecko species that eat fruit and insects. This product contains over 50% real fruit, with banana powder making up 52% of the total formula, giving it an authentic flavor that geckos love. The formula includes 9 different animal protein sources, providing a comprehensive amino acid profile needed for proper growth and development.

The nutritional profile of this product is carefully designed: it contains 23% protein and 1.95% calcium, with an excellent calcium-to-phosphorus ratio of 3.87:1, which is key to preventing metabolic bone disease. The food contains no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives, so it is completely safe for long-term use.

Preparation is simple: mix 5g of powder with water until you get a ketchup-like consistency. Place the prepared food in a shallow dish inside the terrarium and serve 1 to 2 times a week. Remove uneaten food after 24 hours. HabiStat is a renowned British brand with many years of experience producing reptile equipment and food.
